voice.instructions: Speak in a calm, warm and friendly tone, at a relaxed, steady pace, like explaining something to a friend. Clear and plain. No excitement or sales voice.

scenes.title: Autinerary
scenes.subtitle: A life plan built around how you work
scenes.narration: This is Autinerary. It turns a goal into small, clear steps, planned around your energy.

scenes.title: Start without an account
scenes.narration: You can start without an account. Say who you're here for, and what you need today.

scenes.title: Starter resources, right away
scenes.narration: You get starter resources straight away, picked for your answers.

scenes.title: Two quick questions
scenes.narration: When you're ready, a free account takes two quick questions: who you're here for, and one goal.

scenes.title: Help with your goal
scenes.narration: Not sure how to put your goal? Describe it in your own words, then pick a suggestion.

scenes.title: One step at a time
scenes.narration: Your path shows one next step at a time.

scenes.title: Small parts, with tools
scenes.narration: Each step breaks into small parts, with tools that can help.

scenes.title: A plan for low-energy days
scenes.narration: Your calendar has low, balanced and high-energy days, so a hard day still has a plan.

scenes.title: Services rated by people like you
scenes.narration: In ResourceHub, find services rated by people with similar norms.

scenes.title: Advice from people like you
scenes.narration: In Tidbits, read answers from people with similar experiences.

scenes.title: Free during the beta
scenes.subtitle: We don't sell your information, show ads, or use it to train AI.
scenes.narration: Autinerary is free during the beta. We don't sell your information, show ads, or use it to train AI. Start with your starter resources, no account needed.

scenes.title: How to use your Path
scenes.subtitle: One minute
scenes.narration: Here's how to use your Autinerary path.

scenes.title: Your next step
scenes.narration: Your path shows your next step. Open it to see what to do.

scenes.title: What to do
scenes.narration: Each step has small parts to do, and tools that can help.

scenes.title: Tick it off
scenes.narration: When you've done a step, tick its box on the Races page. Your progress fills in as you go.

scenes.title: On a hard day
scenes.narration: On a hard day, open your calendar and choose Low Energy for a lighter plan.

scenes.title: Save what helps
scenes.narration: Find services in ResourceHub, and save the ones you want to come back to.

scenes.title: Look back
scenes.narration: Write in your journal now and then, to see what is working.

scenes.title: Getting started
scenes.narration: The Getting started list on your Path ticks itself off as you try these.

scenes.title: Take it at your pace
scenes.subtitle: Replay the tour any time from How it works, in the top bar.
scenes.narration: Take it at your own pace. You can replay the tour any time from How it works, in the top bar.
